title: End of the first session and his great nephew
summary: The first session ends as Whaley's great nephew Randy arrives, and Whaley says they must still do Venezuela.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: I don't want to tie you up. We've done a tremendous amount of work here.
And if there's anything you want to talk about, Tom, I would love to hear it. Because I don't have to say but two words and that's --
When are you going to record again?
No, sir, we'll have to set a date for another time. We'll find out when your great nephew can bring you back. What's your great nephew's name that brought you out here?
Randy. How is he your great nephew?
What relationship is your nephew to you?

See, Randy's father had four boys. Randy and -- Randy's father's sister had four girls. And I think they're all living. One is up in -- up there beyond Detroit and one's up there in Marlin or Everett. She was with the Commissioner's office. And another one is up in Boston. And where's the other one? I think the other one is up in Detroit, too.
Well, we're going to knock it off, now, Tom. Your great nephew is here.
I'm glad to come out here.
Well, listen, man, it's my pleasure and we're going to do it again whenever your great nephew can --
Remember, we got to do Venezuela.
